name: eleventy-netlify-boilerplate
description: A boilerplate for building a fast static website with the Eleventy static site generator, for deployment to Netlify.

scripts.gemini:server:prestart: npm run gemini:prebuild && npm run gemini:build
scripts.gemini:server:all: npm run gemini:prebuild && npm run gemini:build && npm run gemini:prestart && npm run gemini:start
scripts.gemini: npm run gemini:prebuild && concurrently "npx @11ty/eleventy --watch --quiet --config=.eleventy.config.gemini.js" "npm run gemini:start"
scripts.gemini:server:debug: trash _gemini && npm run gemini:prebuild && concurrently "DEBUG=* npx @11ty/eleventy --watch --quiet --config=.eleventy.config.gemini.js" "npm run gemini:start"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run gemini:build && npm run test:compile && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build && npm run gemini:build && node --test tests/frontend.test.cjs
scripts.test:admin: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node --test tests/admin.test.cjs tests/api.test.cjs
